facts.claim: Explora I (Explora Journeys): Entered service 2023; 63,900 GT; 922 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 248 m length; Explora class.
The Explorair Relax MV is a German powered parachute that was designed by Mathias Mauch and produced by Explorair of Ebringen, Breisgau-Hochschwarzwald in Baden-Württemberg.

catalogSpecs.description: First ship in the Explora Journeys fleet, offering luxury ocean travel with sustainable technology.
